mapper.sql: t.id, t.tx_hash, t.order_id, t.buyer_address, ub.username as buyer_name, t.seller_address, us.username as seller_name, t.amount, t.total_price, t.timestamp
mapper.select: SELECT FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user ub ON t.buyer_address = ub.blockchain_address LEFT JOIN user us ON t.seller_address = us.blockchain_address WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user ub ON t.buyer_address = ub.blockchain_address LEFT JOIN user us ON t.seller_address = us.blockchain_address WHERE t.tx_hash = #{txHash}

SELECT FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user ub ON t.buyer_address = ub.blockchain_address LEFT JOIN user us ON t.seller_address = us.blockchain_address WHERE t.buyer_address = #{buyerAddress} ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC

SELECT FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user ub ON t.buyer_address = ub.blockchain_address LEFT JOIN user us ON t.seller_address = us.blockchain_address WHERE t.seller_address = #{sellerAddress} ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC

SELECT FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user ub ON t.buyer_address = ub.blockchain_address LEFT JOIN user us ON t.seller_address = us.blockchain_address WHERE t.buyer_address = #{userAddress} OR t.seller_address = #{userAddress} ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC
SELECT FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user ub ON t.buyer_address = ub.blockchain_address LEFT JOIN user us ON t.seller_address = us.blockchain_address ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction (tx_hash, order_id, buyer_address, seller_address, amount, total_price, timestamp) VALUES (#{txHash}, #{orderId}, #{buyerAddress}, #{sellerAddress}, #{amount}, #{totalPrice}, #{timestamp})
